en: Let \(R_5\) denote the fifth-order external-to-target energy ratio from R0.18, and write the four real polarization-chart coordinates as \[ (t_P,t_Q,t_B,t_D)=(p+a,-p+a,q+b,-q+b). \] The unique solution \(z_*=(p_*,q_*,x_*)\) in the R0.18 root box makes \((a,b,p,q,x)=(0,0,z_*)\) a stationary point of the full five-variable problem. The five-dimensional Hessian at this point is positive definite, so it is a strict local minimizer of \(R_5\) within this real five-variable family.

The external-to-target ratio \(R=E/T\) used in R0.18 and the target share here satisfy \(J=1/(1+R)\), so a minimizer of \(R\) is a maximizer of \(J\). To cover all points at infinity, I use projective coordinates

zh: 对任意不全为零的 \((\beta,\delta)\in\mathbb C^2\)， R0.13 的第五阶纯非线性能量满足 \[ \frac{X_\infty(\beta,\delta)}{T_\infty(\beta,\delta)} \ge\lambda_*=45.73934896472748\ldots . \] 等号当且仅当 \(\beta=\delta\)、\(4|\beta|^2=\alpha\)，允许任意共同复相位。
en: For every nonzero \((\beta,\delta)\in\mathbb C^2\), the fifth-order purely nonlinear energy in R0.13 satisfies \[ \frac{X_\infty(\beta,\delta)}{T_\infty(\beta,\delta)} \ge\lambda_*=45.73934896472748\ldots . \] Equality holds if and only if \(\beta=\delta\) and \(4|\beta|^2=\alpha\), with an arbitrary common complex phase allowed.

zh: 在整洁有理点，振幅与四个实极化图坐标的联合 Hessian 正定。 这是点态二阶结论；由于该点的一阶梯度不为零，它本身仍不是已证明的局部极小点。
en: At the clean rational point, the joint Hessian in the amplitude and the four real polarization-chart coordinates is positive definite. This is a pointwise second-order result. Because the first-order gradient there is nonzero, the point itself is not yet a proved local minimizer.

zh: 两个盒的半径均为 \(10^{-6}\)。根 I 的最大 Krawczyk 包含比约为 \(0.002263\)， 根 II 约为 \(0.129179\)，都严格小于 1。 根 I 的商 Hessian 在整个盒上正定，所以 \(E/T\) 严格局部最小、\(J\) 严格局部最大； 根 II 的有理测试方向给出异号二次型，从而认证为鞍点。
en: Both boxes have radius \(10^{-6}\). The maximum Krawczyk inclusion ratio is about \(0.002263\) for root I and \(0.129179\) for root II; both are strictly below 1. The quotient Hessian at root I is positive definite throughout the box, so \(E/T\) has a strict local minimum and \(J\) has a strict local maximum. A rational test direction at root II gives an indefinite quadratic form, certifying a saddle point.

zh: 不过，尖锐极化 \(w_A,w_B\) 是为全空间反例专门选择的。当前尚未证明它们由原始八个极化经过真实 Taylor 递推产生。若实际生成子空间始终避开这些方向，仍可能得到更好的闭合。
en: However, the sharp polarizations \(w_A,w_B\) were chosen specifically for the full-space counterexample. I have not proved that the true Taylor recurrence generates them from the original eight polarizations. If the generated subspace always avoids these directions, a better closure may still be possible.

zh: 全空间欧氏—纵向解析范数的半径损失严格为二阶；普通一阶 Cauchy–Kowalevski 主级数不能在这个空间闭合。
en: The radius loss in the full-space Euclidean–longitudinal analytic norm is exactly second order; the standard first-order Cauchy–Kowalevski majorant series cannot close in this space.

zh: 我把 R0.19 的局部极值问题扩展到整个正参数闭包 \([0,\infty]^3\)。两个半径 \(10^{-6}\) 的有理 Krawczyk 盒分别认证一个严格局部最大点和一个非退化鞍点； 根盒与两个精确边界条带之外的全局 Bernstein 细分以零未决盒结束。
en: I extended the R0.19 local-extremum problem to the full positive-parameter closure \([0,\infty]^3\). Two rational Krawczyk boxes of radius \(10^{-6}\) certify a strict local maximum and a nondegenerate saddle point. The global Bernstein subdivision outside the root boxes and two exact boundary strips ends with no undecided boxes.

zh: 我证明连通三波网络若要张成三维，至少需要五个无符号波数，并构造了两个只共享一个波数的整数频率蝶形。 在一个四参数极化中，临界传递与总涡量拉伸满足精确关系 \(\mathfrak S=-(\sqrt2+1)\mathfrak T\)，而外部非线性平方范数严格为正。
en: I prove that a connected triad network needs at least five unsigned wavenumbers to span three dimensions, and I construct two integer-frequency butterflies that share only one wavenumber. In a four-parameter polarization, the critical transfer and total vorticity stretching satisfy the exact relation \(\mathfrak S=-(\sqrt2+1)\mathfrak T\), while the squared norm of the external nonlinearity is strictly positive.

zh: 我把 R0.7 的共面六模态中心替换为两个只共享一个波数的三波网络。 五个无符号波数已经是连通非共面网络的最小规模。 一个四参数极化同时产生正涡量拉伸和严格频谱泄漏；在短时 Galerkin 计算中，生成模态延长了临界能量增长。
en: I replaced the R0.7 coplanar six-mode center with two triad networks that share only one wavenumber. Five unsigned wavenumbers are the minimum size of a connected noncoplanar network. A four-parameter polarization produces both positive vorticity stretching and strict spectral leakage; in the short-time Galerkin calculation, the generated modes prolong the growth of the critical energy.

zh: 负频率系数取复共轭，因此场为实值；每个极化都在对应波数的正交平面内。 \(B_n,D_n\) 是 R0.11 中同时消去 \(a_n-b_n\) 与 \(a_n-d_n\) 中心差频的单位镜像极化。 本文主表取 \(\varepsilon=0.2\)。

The main table uses \(\varepsilon=0.2\).

zh: 完整递推保留右端产生的每个非零频率。比较用的“接力递推”则在每一步投影到 \[ \{\pm P_{n-1},\pm Q_{n-1},\pm b_n,\pm d_n, \pm a_n,\pm P_n,\pm Q_n,\pm a_{n+1}\}. \] 两者使用相同初值、热乘子和二维 Leray 投影；差别只有是否删除外部频率。
en: The full recurrence retains every nonzero frequency generated by the right-hand side. The comparison 'relay recurrence' projects at each step onto \[ \{\pm P_{n-1},\pm Q_{n-1},\pm b_n,\pm d_n, \pm a_n,\pm P_n,\pm Q_n,\pm a_{n+1}\}. \] Both recurrences use the same initial data, heat multiplier, and two-dimensional Leray projection; they differ only in whether out-of-family frequencies are removed.

zh: 这里没有稠密包的时间顺序、热积分或第二 Picard 余项估计。 我也没有完成文献优先权检索，因此不把这些初等代数命题称为新的公开定理。 本笔记没有证明奇性或全局正则。
en: I have not established a time ordering for the dense packet, a heat-integral estimate, or a bound for the second Picard remainder. I have also not completed a priority search, so I do not present these elementary algebraic statements as new theorems. This note proves neither singularity nor global regularity.

en: The right-hand side at the root center is a positive rational number but not a rational square. Every recurrence coefficient therefore has a unique form \(A+Bt\), and exact rational pairs \((A,B)\) are used to test whether it is zero.

zh: 结论只覆盖 R0.20 有理根中心的纯非线性十阶系数。它不覆盖整个根盒，不包含热项，也没有证明三维 Navier–Stokes 的全局正则性或有限时奇性。
en: The conclusion covers only the tenth-order purely nonlinear coefficient at the rational root center from R0.20. It does not cover the full root box or include heat terms, and it proves neither global regularity nor finite-time singularity for the three-dimensional Navier–Stokes equations.

zh: 三个标签的最小叶数为 \(6,5,11\)，所以第一次分别出现在时间阶 \(5,4,10\)。完整有序递推到十阶后有 1720 个精确非零输出标签。
en: The three labels have minimum leaf counts \(6,5,11\), so they first appear at Taylor orders \(5,4,10\), respectively. The complete ordered recurrence through order ten contains 1,720 exactly nonzero output labels.

zh: 同一标签上，R0.22 专门选择的零纵向尖锐极化给出 \(70.2619267363\ldots\)。两者之比是 \(0.0043346408\ldots\)，即约 \(0.43\%\)。
en: For the same label, the specially chosen sharp polarization with zero longitudinal component in R0.22 gives \(70.2619267363\ldots\). The ratio is \(0.0043346408\ldots\), or about \(0.43\%\).

zh: 我把 R0.22 的全空间反例放回真实八模态 Taylor 递推。\(N=2\) 的两个尖锐标签及其极化投影确实出现，没有精确选择律把它们排除；但归一化相互作用只达到专门尖锐极化的约 \(0.43\%\)。
en: I inserted the full-space counterexample from R0.22 into the true eight-mode Taylor recurrence. Both sharp labels for \(N=2\) and their polarization projections do appear, and no exact selection rule removes them. The normalized interaction, however, is only about \(0.43\%\) of that for the specially chosen sharp polarization.

zh: 下一项判别是 \(N=3\)，不是继续堆十二阶图
en: The next test is \(N=3\), not another twelfth-order diagram

zh: 一个精确中心、一个首次相遇
en: One exact center and one first encounter

zh: 锥极限递推落在一个二次域中
en: The cone-limit recurrence lies in a quadratic number field

zh: 作用。
en: Purpose.

zh: R0.22 后最直接的希望，是八个初始模态生成的系数始终与尖锐方向正交。R0.23 已排除这一点。
en: After R0.22, the most direct hope was that the coefficients generated by the eight initial modes would always remain orthogonal to the sharp direction. R0.23 rules this out.

zh: “弱解不唯一”“存在粗糙自相似解”“数值计算出现高涡量增长”都不等价于 “某个光滑初值的经典解有限时爆破”。记录这类结果时，我会同时写出初值正则性、能量不等式、适当性、外力和解类。
en: Nonuniqueness of weak solutions, rough self-similar solutions, and numerical growth of vorticity do not imply finite-time blow-up of a classical solution from smooth initial data. When I record such a result, I also state the regularity of the initial data, the energy inequality, suitability, forcing, and solution class.

zh: \(-\Delta p=\partial_i\partial_j(u_i u_j)\)。局部速度结构会通过 Riesz 变换影响远处，局部化估计产生压力尾项。
en: \(-\Delta p=\partial_i\partial_j(u_i u_j)\). A local velocity structure can affect distant regions through the Riesz transforms, and localized estimates therefore acquire pressure tails.

zh: \(N=2\) 的两个输入标签第一次出现在 5 阶与 4 阶，输出第一次出现在 10 阶。 两个输入对 R0.22 尖锐横向方向的投影都精确非零，对称根相互作用也不精确抵消。 但实际归一化增益为 \(0.3045602145\ldots\)，只相当于同标签专门尖锐极化的 \(0.0043346408\ldots\)。
en: For \(N=2\), the two input labels first appear at orders five and four, and the output first appears at order ten. Both inputs have exactly nonzero projections onto the sharp transverse direction from R0.22, and the two symmetric root interactions do not cancel exactly. The actual normalized gain is \(0.3045602145\ldots\), only \(0.0043346408\ldots\) times the gain from the specially chosen sharp polarization with the same label.

zh: 八个 signed 初始频率在有理 charge–offset 坐标下恰好构成一个线性变换立方体。 因而 \(L\) 叶支持精确含 \((L+1)^3\) 个标签；偶数 \(L\) 去掉零频后少一个。 不可压缩恒等式与纵向半范数同时消除了表面上的 \(4^n\) 壳层损失。
en: In rational charge–offset coordinates, the eight signed initial frequencies form an exact linear image of a cube. The support with \(L\) leaves therefore contains exactly \((L+1)^3\) labels, or one fewer when \(L\) is even and the zero frequency is removed. The incompressibility identity and the longitudinal seminorm together remove the apparent \(4^n\) shell loss.

zh: 这是计算机辅助有限模型定理，不是三维 Navier–Stokes 的 PDE 定理； 第六阶及以上余项、粘性热衰减、横向无限维扰动和逐壳迭代仍未控制。
en: This is a computer-assisted theorem for a finite model, not a PDE theorem for the three-dimensional Navier–Stokes equations. Remainders of order six and above, viscous heat decay, transverse infinite-dimensional perturbations, and shell-by-shell iteration remain uncontrolled.

zh: 这些是精确低阶系数、频率几何和模式级算子结论。 解析序列空间中的无限卷积估计、八阶以上余项、正时间目标下界与逐壳迭代仍未证明。
en: These results concern exact low-order coefficients, frequency geometry, and mode-level operators. Infinite convolution estimates in analytic sequence spaces, remainders above order eight, positive-time lower bounds for the target, and shell-by-shell iteration have not been proved.

zh: 正内部恰有两个驻点；精确边界分类与零未决盒的全局 Bernstein 排除证明，第一个根是所选第五阶模型正参数闭包上的唯一全局目标比例最大点。
en: There are exactly two stationary points in the positive interior. Exact boundary classification and a global Bernstein exclusion with no undecided boxes show that the first root is the unique global maximizer of the target share on the positive-parameter closure of the selected fifth-order model.

zh: 驻点处三变量 Hessian 的逐项区间误差小于 \(4.53\times10^{-28}\)， 三行严格对角占优余量均为正，所以该点是反对称图中的严格局部极小。 外部/目标比约为 \(15.801442609207276\)，目标能量比例约为 \(5.9518698677\%\)。
en: At the stationary point, every entry of the three-variable Hessian has interval error below \(4.53\times10^{-28}\), and all three strict diagonal-dominance margins are positive. The point is therefore a strict local minimum on the antisymmetric chart. The external-to-target ratio is about \(15.801442609207276\), and the target-energy share is about \(5.9518698677\%\).

zh: 足够光滑的初值产生唯一局部强解；如果最大存在时间有限，那么某个临界或超临界正则量必须发散。 问题被压缩为：排除有限时发散。
en: Sufficiently smooth initial data produce a unique local strong solution. If the maximal existence time is finite, some critical or supercritical regularity quantity must diverge. The problem is therefore reduced to ruling out finite-time divergence.

zh: 我从 Fourier–Leray 三波核、螺旋分解和临界缩放出发，逐步构造近对角频率包、短时泄漏模型与最小非共面网络。
en: I began with the Fourier–Leray triad kernel, helical decomposition, and critical scaling, then built near-diagonal frequency packets, a short-time leakage model, and a minimal non-coplanar network.

zh: 我检查了稀疏和稠密跨壳接力、五阶树、复振幅与极化优化，并用区间方法核对驻点和 Hessian。
en: I checked sparse and dense cross-shell relays, fifth-order trees, complex amplitudes, and polarization optimization, then used interval methods to verify the stationary points and Hessian.

zh: 我检查临界小数据门、横向边带的线性增长、二次反馈和正时间预解拼接。最终优化只回到经典临界尺度。
en: I checked the critical small-data gate, linear growth of transverse sidebands, quadratic feedback, and positive-time resolvent patching. The final optimization returned only the classical critical scale.

zh: 我依次处理六阶返回路径、仿射矩提升、完整热核符号、十阶以上目标尾和最后的八阶有限关口。
en: I treated, in order, the sixth-order return paths, affine moment lifts, the full heat-kernel sign, target tails of order ten and above, and the final finite eighth-order gate.

zh: 我依次检查有符号涡量核、压力 Hessian、局部化交换子、远场四极矩、三段预算和时间积分。远场确有增益，但近场最终仍回到三维涡量拉伸。
en: I checked the signed vorticity kernel, pressure Hessian, localization commutator, far-field quadrupole, three-zone budget, and time integration. The far field does gain decay, but the near field ultimately returns to three-dimensional vorticity stretching.

zh: 我在同一个约化系统上逐步加入尾部分离、端点凸性、乘法荷特征、仿射权和乘积仿射权，把认证半径压到严格窄区间。
en: Within the same reduced system, I successively added tail separation, endpoint convexity, multiplicative charge characters, affine weights, and product-affine weights, narrowing the certified radius to a rigorous small interval.

zh: 我重新检查完整非线性核、Leray 极化、Duhamel 热分母、多输出聚合和 R0.59 高频包的真实动力学结构。
en: I returned to the full nonlinear kernel and checked Leray polarization, Duhamel heat denominators, multi-output aggregation, and the actual dynamical structure of the R0.59 high-frequency packet.
